def _sign_rsa(hash_algorithm_name: str, sig_base_str: str, rsa_private_key: str
    ):
    """
    Sign a signature base string using RSA with the specified hash algorithm.
    
    The signature is calculated using RSASSA-PKCS1-V1_5 as defined in
    section 3.4.3 of RFC 5849.
    """
    # Validate the private key
    if rsa_private_key is None or rsa_private_key == '':
        raise ValueError('rsa_private_key must not be None or empty')
    
    # Get the RSA algorithm implementation
    alg = _get_jwt_rsa_algorithm(hash_algorithm_name)
    
    # Prepare the private key (this will raise InvalidKeyError if invalid)
    key = _prepare_key_plus(alg, rsa_private_key)
    
    # Sign the signature base string
    # The signature base string only contains printable US-ASCII characters
    sig_base_str_bytes = sig_base_str.encode('ascii')
    signature_bytes = alg.sign(sig_base_str_bytes, key)
    
    # Return base64-encoded signature
    return binascii.b2a_base64(signature_bytes)[:-1].decode('utf-8')
